novel_features.description: Scan, isolate or release a device by name (or scan a whole customer): prints the exact ESET task first and creates it only with --yes; with --wait it polls the task runs until they finish. Over MCP the root --yes is never forwarded, so the tool only previews.

novel_features.name: Patch backlog
novel_features.description: Available-but-not-installed patches ranked by the devices and CVE risk they fix per customer, plus recent failed patch attempts by reason.

novel_features.name: Morning triage queue
novel_features.description: Endpoint detections in a window (v1 has no resolved state) and open incidents in one ranked queue, worst first, with device, customer and a suggested next command.

novel_features.name: Stale device list
novel_features.description: Devices that stopped checking in for N days, most stale first, with customer and group path.

novel_features.name: Latest detections
novel_features.description: The newest endpoint detections straight from ESET for a time window and minimum severity, with device and customer names when the mirror is synced.

novel_features.name: Device profile
novel_features.description: Everything about one device in one call: health, recent detections, CVEs, pending patches and recent scans, with partial-failure reporting.

novel_features.name: Incident context
novel_features.description: One incident with its comments and every linked detection and device, falling back from v1 to v2 detection lookups.

novel_features.name: Vulnerability rollup
novel_features.description: Vulnerable devices, CVE counts by severity, top CVEs and patchable share per customer from a live vulnerability scan.

novel_features.name: Executable lookup
novel_features.description: Turn an MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash or a name into the executable UUID that 'executables block' needs, with blocked state and signer.

novel_features.name: Policy decoder
novel_features.description: Decode a policy's base64 and LZMA settings blobs into readable JSON, list settings that mention a word, or pull one value by path.

novel_features.name: Policy clone
novel_features.description: Copy an existing policy's feature settings byte for byte into a new policy under a new name; preview unless --yes.
